title: Machine Learning Based Modeling to Estimate Potential Distribution of Current Remerging hMPV in Asia Regions
content: Recently hMPV has been reported across countries in Asia regions. Among those countries, hMPV has been reported in several locations and in subcontinent. Considering the records of hMPV in this subcontinent, this study aims to use a machine learning model to estimate the potential distribution of current remerging hMPV in Asian regions using bioclimatic variables. The mean temperature of the driest quarter, followed by the precipitation seasonality and the annual mean temperature, were the climate variables that have the most contribution to the suitable areas of hMPV. Based on the model, areas with potential areas have preferences in temperate regions with north latitude of 210-230 and east longitude of 720-750. While there is an area covering north latitude of 130-170 and east longitude of 730-750, indicating potential preferences in tropical regions. In spite of hMPV preferences in temperate regions, potential distribution to tropical regions, mainly in Southeast Asia, should be vigilant.
